notes:
Inbound self-serve signup (trial API key used in prod-like widget). Discovery call 2026-02-20 with AE Jordan & SE Priya. Main issue: perception of poor latency by EU customers; customer runs hosted-api against us-east by default (they assumed single regional endpoint). Observed symptoms: long tail 400-700ms token latencies and occasional 5-8s timeouts when prompt length >4k tokens. They also hit client-side timeouts frequently (frontend aborts at 8-12s).

Key quotes: "Our EU users complain the chat lags — page times out and we lose context".

Technical notes (from SE debug):
- SDK: using community JS wrapper with default client timeout (10s) -> needs raising for streaming/long completions.
- Region: requests routed to us-east (low-cost default) but primary user base in EU. Recommend eu-west pinned region for lower RTT.
- Prompt practices: few-shot + long system prompt + 3-4 previous messages causing 2-3k token context; trimming and canonicalization suggested.
- Workarounds tried: reduced max_tokens, toggled streaming (helped perceived latency for UX), naive batching caused increased SLO misses.

Requested deliverables: perf tuning doc (region guidance, client timeout patterns, prompt-length heuristics), sample SDK config snippets, short checklist for frontend timeouts vs server SLOs. Customer wants quick wins before procurement decision.
